Leo Bianchi  
Staff Frontend Engineer | CapitalFlow Solutions | Bengaluru, India  
Email: leobianchi@capitalflowsolutions.com | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/leobianchi  

**Professional Summary**  
13-year veteran in fintech frontend engineering, driving scalable architectures and performance benchmarks. Spearheaded design systems adoption across 3+ enterprise platforms, reducing technical debt by 40% and accelerating feature rollouts. Architectural decisions at CapitalFlow Solutions have enabled 3x faster API response times and 25% reduction in QA cycles.  

**Professional Experience**  
*CapitalFlow Solutions* | Staff Frontend Engineer | 2020–present  
- Architect and maintain GraphQL APIs for real-time financial dashboards, achieving 95%+ query latency reduction through schema optimization and DataLoader integration.  
- Led TypeScript refactoring of legacy monorepo, improving type safety and reducing runtime errors by 65% across 12 microfrontends.  
- Implemented CI/CD pipelines with Jest and Cypress, cutting regression detection time by 50% and enabling 2-week sprints.  
- Redesigned core UI components using design systems, standardizing 80% of UI elements and reducing development overhead by 30%.  

*NexusLend* | Senior Frontend Engineer | 2014–2017  
- Built RESTful APIs for loan origination workflows, achieving 98% API success rate and 20% improvement in user onboarding time.  
- Optimized web performance for high-traffic dashboards, reducing page load times by 45% via lazy loading and code-splitting.  
- Collaborated with backend teams to unify data models, reducing redundant API calls by 35% and improving data consistency.  

*FinTech Innovators* | Lead Frontend Architect | 2017–2020  
- Designed and deployed React-based microfrontend architecture, enabling 50% faster deployment cycles and 2x scalability.  
- Pioneered design system adoption, creating reusable components that reduced UI development time by 40% across 5 products.  
- Migrated critical applications to Node.js, improving server-side rendering performance by 30% and reducing memory usage by 25%.  

*PayNet Financial* | Junior Frontend Developer | 2011–2014  
- Developed payment gateway UIs with React, improving user conversion rates by 15% through A/B testing and UX refinements.  
- Automated 70% of frontend test cases using Selenium, reducing QA manual effort by 50% and increasing test coverage to 85%.  

**Projects**  
- **Design System Migration** (FinTech Innovators): Redesigned 150+ UI components into a centralized design system, reducing development time by 30% and ensuring cross-product consistency.  
- **GraphQL Performance Optimization** (CapitalFlow Solutions): Refactored 200+ queries to use batched requests and caching, cutting average latency from 1.2s to 0.3s.  
- **React Microfrontend Architecture** (NexusLend): Built modular UI framework supporting 5+ independent teams, reducing integration conflicts by 60%.  
- **TypeScript Enterprise Adoption** (CapitalFlow Solutions): Spearheaded type-driven development across 10+ projects, eliminating 80% of runtime errors in legacy codebases.  

**Technical Skills**  
- **GraphQL**: Designed and scaled APIs for 3+ fintech platforms, reducing round-trip times by 50% through schema normalization.  
- **React**: Engineered scalable UI frameworks for 5+ enterprise applications, improving rendering efficiency by 40% via virtual DOM optimizations.  
- **TypeScript**: Central to architecture at CapitalFlow Solutions, enforcing type safety across 12 microfrontends and mentoring 5+ junior developers.  
- **Node.js**: Built server-side rendering pipelines for 3+ high-traffic applications, improving load times by 35% and reducing server costs by 20%.  
- **REST API Design**: Standardized 15+ API endpoints across NexusLend’s product suite, achieving 99% uptime and 25% faster data retrieval.  
- **Web Performance Optimization**: Reduced critical rendering path by 30% through lazy loading and code-splitting in FinTech Innovators’ dashboards.  
- **Design Systems**: Owned production-ready systems at 2+ companies, standardizing 80% of UI elements and reducing development overhead by 40%.  
- **Test Automation**: Integrated Jest and Cypress into CI/CD pipelines, cutting regression detection time by 50% and enabling 2-week sprints.
